games.title: Fool's Mate
games.note: Two pawn moves open the diagonal to the white King; the Queen mates on the second move.

games.title: Scholar's Mate
games.note: Queen and Bishop aim at f7, the square only the King defends; 3...Nf6 attacks the Queen and lets it mate.

games.title: Légal's Mate
games.note: White gives the Queen with 5.Nxe5!; Black takes it, and three minor pieces mate.

games.title: Réti–Tartakower
games.note: A Queen sacrifice on d8, a double check, and a Bishop mates from the square the Queen died on.

games.title: The Opera Game
games.note: Development, open lines, a pin: Morphy gives a Knight, a Rook and the Queen, and mates with the last Rook.

games.title: Lasker–Thomas
games.note: The Queen is given on h7 and the black King is driven from h8 to g1, where a King move mates it.
